title: Maa, laa, laata, in resembling laysa, and laa of denying the genus
arabic: ما ولا ولات المشبهات بليس، ولا النافية للجنس

blocks.en: Maa and Laa, the two likened to laysa
{{term|أفعال}} = Strongest governors.
{{term|ما و لا}} = Weak governors.
Zaid is not standing (the sentence is underlined and marked JIK)

Laata
{{term|لات}} will govern like {{term|ليس}}. It gives its Ism {{ruling|رفع}} & its Khabar {{ruling|نصب}}.
Exclusivities of لات
1) {{condition|Both, its Ism & its Khabar MUST mean "Time"}} or {{condition|just its Ism must mean "Time"}}.
2) {{ruling|Its Ism or its Khabar MUST be dropped}}. Both can not be present at the same time. {{ruling|Dropping the Ism is preferred}}.
e.g. Be silent, it is not a time of speaking
BOTH I/K = Time; الحِينُ is boxed; = JIK
Be silent, it is not a time of speaking (written again, with حِينُ)
Only I = Time; ثَابِتًا لَكُمْ is boxed and the arrow points to it; = JIK
Zaid regretted, and it was not a time of regret; the arrow puts the dropped ism الحِينُ back in

blocks.ar: نَدِمَ زَيْدٌ وَلَات حِينُ نَدَامَةٍ (ثابتًا لَهُ)
blocks.en: Zaid regretted, and it was not a time of regret; (ثابتًا لَهُ) is boxed
Q. Does the word {{term|حِين}} need to be used all the time? A. No. {{condition|Any word which means time}}.
e.g. it is not an hour of speaking / a time of speaking
The laa that negates the whole kind

blocks.caption: صفحة رسم: فوق: مضاف / شبهُ المضاف. في إطار على اليسار طَالعٌ جَبَلًا، وسهم منه إلى شبهُ المضاف، وتحته (هو) فاعل ومفعول به وكلمة If. خط من هذا الإطار إلى إطار على اليمين فيه طالِعُ جَبَلٍ، وMountain climber بجانبه. وبينهما فعل فاعل مفعول وتحتها جز ومبتدا. وعلى اليمين (⟨?⟩ ⟨?⟩ زَيْدٍ) وتحته نَصْرُ زَيْدٍ. وفي الأسفل كِتَابُ زَيْدًا، وقاتِلٌ زَيْدًا وقاتِلُ زَيْدٍ.
blocks.caption_en: A drawing page: at the top مضاف / شبهُ المضاف. A left box holds طَالعٌ جَبَلًا with an arrow to شبهُ المضاف; under it (هو) is labelled فاعل, جَبَلًا is labelled مفعول به, and "If" is written beside it. A line runs from it to a right box holding طالِعُ جَبَلٍ, next to "Mountain climber". Between them فعل فاعل مفعول, with جز and مبتدا under it. On the right a bracketed phrase ending in زَيْدٍ whose first words are unreadable, and under it نَصْرُ زَيْدٍ. At the bottom كِتَابُ زَيْدًا, and قاتِلٌ زَيْدًا beside قاتِلُ زَيْدٍ.

blocks.ar: A {{condition|single word on it's own}} as the Ism of لا نفي الجنس will be {{ruling|مبني على الفتح}} e.g. {{example|لَا رَجُلَ مَوْجُوْدٌ}} (note beside رَجُلَ: a word on it's own, not a construction)
blocks.en: A {{condition|single word on its own}} as the ism of laa li-nafyil-jins will be {{ruling|mabni on fathah}}, e.g. no man exists. (Note beside رَجُلَ: a word on its own, not a construction.)
Examples of mabni words: kayfa on fathah, amsi on kasrah, ba'du on dammah, idh on sukoon
No man exists. The لا (arrow to the boxed رَجُلَ) totally encompasses the اسم. A line under the sentence is labelled ⟨?⟩.

items: The لا has overpowered the اسم because of {{condition|negating the whole genus}} which has resulted to the اسم adopting a quality of حرف i.e. {{term|بناء}} (to be مبني)
blocks.en: Rajula is mabni on fathah and mansoob in position. Why? The laa has overpowered the ism by negating the whole genus, so the ism takes on a quality of a harf: binaa' (being mabni).

blocks.en: If the ism of laa li-nafyil-jins is {{condition|definite}}, the laa {{ruling|stops governing}} and becomes {{term|muhmalah}}.

blocks.en: The sifah of the ism of laa li-nafyil-jins

blocks.ar: {{term|Ma'toof}} of اسم لا نفي جنس {{condition|when the لا is not repeated}}.
blocks.en: The ma'toof of the ism of laa li-nafyil-jins, {{condition|when the laa is not repeated}}.

blocks.ar: {{example|لَا رَجُلَ وَامْرَأَةً / إمْرَأَةٌ قائِمَانِ}} ({{ruling|always 2 options only}})
blocks.en: Neither a man nor a woman is standing (always 2 options only)
Types of laa

items: 4) {{term|لا الزائدة}} = مَا جَاءَ زَيْدٌ ولَا بَكْرٌ ({{ruling|Does not govern}})
blocks.en: 1) Laa resembling laysa (governs). 2) Laa negating the genus (governs). 3) The negating laa, laa yadribu (does not govern). 4) The extra laa, Zayd did not come, nor Bakr (does not govern).

blocks.ar: For this لا to be zaidah, it {{condition|must be preceded with a negation}}. It will be translated as {{term|neither}}.
blocks.en: For this laa to be zaa'idah, it {{condition|must be preceded by a negation}}. It is translated as {{term|neither}}.

items: 6) {{term|لا بمعنى غير}} = أَعْبُدُ اللٰهَ بِلَا شَرِيْكٍ = (بِغَيْرِ شَرِيْكٍ)
blocks.en: 5) The inactive laa: no man is standing. 6) Laa meaning ghayr: I worship Allah without a partner (= without a partner).

blocks.ar: For this لا to be بمعنى غير، it {{condition|must be preceded by a حرف جر}}، mostly "{{ruling|بـ}}".
blocks.en: For this laa to mean ghayr, it {{condition|must be preceded by a harf jarr}}, mostly {{ruling|bi}}.
